frozen_note: A rules file is never edited once a pick has been made under it. A rule change is a NEW file (rules_v2.json), a new hound_version, and a one-line change to config/gematria/active.json. Past picks keep the version they were made under.
origin: The structure mirrors the posts (research/rabbitszn/METHOD.md): a headline count several other numbers equal outweighs a loose match (3.0 against 1.0), and each side is scored on its own world so the other result's matches are the warning bullets. Weights are tiered by how often each kind of coincidence appears in the 18 documented RabbitSZN picks (research/rabbitszn/METHOD.md): kinds that appear in most of his posts are 1.0, kinds in two or fewer posts are 0.5. The tiers are NOT fitted to outcomes (no outcome was used) and 18 picks could not support a fit anyway.
